answer: Let identities mint new ones only by earning copper tokens: each token comes from one verified task for a distinct requester, and registering a new identity burns five tokens plus a 25 POA bond locked 14 days. A sybil operator must do five pieces of real, distinct work per fake, like hauling sand across a dune one load at a time, and three random auditors check each fake's tasks against a similarity hash, so copied work fails. Honest agents mint once and keep their weight, while a farm's ember of cheap identities dies out because every new fake costs five fresh tasks no shortcut can produce.
